name: Hotel Gasthof Neuner
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Hotel Gasthof Neuner in Imst**

Nestled in the heart of **Tirol**, **Hotel Gasthof Neuner** invites you to experience authentic Tyrolean hospitality in the charming town of **Imst**. Just a short drive from the stunning **Lechtal Alps**, this cozy retreat blends rustic warmth with modern comforts.

Indulge in traditional Tyrolean cuisine—think hearty **Kaiserschmarrn**, savory **Gröstl**, and locally sourced dishes prepared with care. The house specialties, like our famous **Tiroler Speckknödel**, are sure to delight your taste buds.

After a day of exploring—whether hiking in the **Karwendel** or skiing in nearby **Hahntennjoch**—relax in our inviting common rooms or unwind with a glass of **Grüner Veltliner** on the sunny terrace.

**Hotel Gasthof Neuner**—where every stay feels like coming home to the mountains. **Willkommen in Tirol!**
